prompt: The query in the editor has one mistake. Fix it so that it answers this question: for each Voltmarkt store (stores.store_code), how many orders did it take in each quarter of 2025? order_ts holds UTC time: take the quarter of the UTC day. Return five columns, in this order: store_code, q1_orders, q2_orders, q3_orders and q4_orders. A quarter in which a store took no orders shows 0, not missing. Return one row for each store with orders in 2025. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, look at what each CASE gives for an order of another quarter, and what SUM makes of a quarter with none.
A CASE with no ELSE gives a missing value; when no order of a store falls in a quarter, the sum is missing instead of 0.
starter_sql:
SELECT s.store_code,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(o.order_ts) = 1 THEN 1 END) AS q1_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(o.order_ts) = 2 THEN 1 END) AS q2_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(o.order_ts) = 3 THEN 1 END) AS q3_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(o.order_ts) = 4 THEN 1 END) AS q4_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.store_code
why_this_works: With ELSE 0 every order adds 0 or 1 to each quarter, so a quarter a store had no orders in sums to 0 instead of missing.
